name: seated cross body punch on a chair
description: A seated punching drill that raises your heart rate and works the chest, shoulders and trunk.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Raise your fists to guard position.
Punch one arm across your body, rotating the trunk slightly.
Pull it back and punch with the other arm.
